description: RigReceipts helps owner-operators and carriers evaluate a specific freight offer against their own operating costs, deadhead, all-mile break-even, and target economics. It returns transparent ACCEPT, COUNTER, or PASS decision support without searching for, negotiating, booking, or dispatching freight.

defaultPrompt: Use RigReceipts to tell me if this load makes economic sense.
